amendments.reason: Decision Log 7 of the W44 charter v1.3 (ea487a17, merged as 08994111): the parent's five rulings on G0's handed-back items (claims 5.202 section 10), executed as ONE amendment of part 2 before any fit render: (1) the receded light document may name sizeHeavySecondShare, move 3's fifth leaf; (2) the photo cells leave move 1's within clause; (3) hc-text-7 is a two-band text stratum T; (4) 14 fit scenes per scale; (5) a candidate's identity is patch-and-digest

rulings.1: the receded light document may name sizeHeavySecondShare as a difference over its active document (X44 narrowed by one difference); move 3 gains it as a fifth leaf
rulings.2: the photo cells leave move 1's within clause (still in the regression budget)
rulings.3: hc-text-7 is a fourth stratum T, out of F, read on two bands: fidelity and change on T1-fine, the away veto on T1-low, T1 recorded; the full close does not require a T cell within
rulings.4: fourteen fit scenes per scale among the fine backdrops, not thirteen
rulings.5: a candidate's identity to c05 is patch-and-digest (the glass0.250 key); byte identity is the sealed documents'

to.unit: signed fraction, named in the receded light document as a difference over its active document (one leaf for both scales; the 1x width is inherited at 0, so the plan declines at dpr 1)
to.domainRelativeTo: the active light document's sizeHeavySecondShare at the joint point: the receded share is in [0, the active share]
to.gridUnit: fraction of the active share (0 switches the second tap off in the receded pose; 1 is the inherited value). When the active share is 0 the grid is the one point 0.
to.inherited: sizeScatterFloor2x, sizeScatterRampReach2xPx and the second tap's widths (sizeHeavySecondSigma, sizeHeavySecondSigma2x) stay inherited from the active document
to.why: G0's ladders: the receded document inherits the second tap's share and width and no receded leaf can take them off; at C 0.5 x 3 CSS px the receded checkerboard-8 mid cell went 1.01 -> 2.56 and the receded pitch-16 cells read 2.33-3.59 (claims 5.202 section 7; charter Decision Log 7 item 1)

ops.to: under family C the receded share lands at or near 0 (charter v1.3, Design, move 3)

ops.from: the receded document names exactly its 0.5 twin's keys (X44): sizeScatterFloor2x, the second tap and the reach come from the active document as moves 1 and 2 leave them
ops.to: the receded document names exactly its 0.5 twin's keys (X44) and, by Decision Log 7 item 1, sizeHeavySecondShare as a difference over its active document; sizeScatterFloor2x, the reach and the second tap's widths come from the active document as moves 1 and 2 leave them

ops.from: every F cell of `cells` within, AND every pitch-16 (`checkerboard`) and photo cell of `cells` within (T1 output 1)
ops.to: every F cell of `cells` within, AND every pitch-16 (`checkerboard`) cell of `cells` within (T1 output 1); the photo cells of `cells` are read, out of the clause and still in the regression budget (Decision Log 7 item 2: no family moves them, 0.62-0.70 across A, B and C on the ladders; W43's named tone gap)

to.fine: T1-fine: the SD of L - G(L, sigma 4 device px), linear luminance, over the native silhouette eroded 4 CSS px
to.low: T1-low: the SD of G(L, sigma 4 device px) over the same support
to.outputs: T1's three outputs per cell on each band, at the cell's own bar and code (the seven runs are pixel-identical, so every statistic's separation is 0 and the bar is 0.5 code)
to.t1: recorded on every T cell, read by no clause
to.fullClose: does not require a T cell within
to.selection: T is outside F u C u P: the selection metric and every move objective do not read it
to.implementation: packages/calibration/results/2026-10-03-w44-g1-refit/cuts/t1.py and readings.py, pinned below with test_t1.py
to.why: T1 reads the hc-text-7 cells under (0.79-0.89 on c05) while the fine band reads them x1.9-8.5 over, and every lever that removes fine structure takes T1 further under (charter Decision Log 7 item 3)

ops.from: 2x WebGPU rest, spans mid and thick (96-160), fit cells, F u C u P
ops.to: 2x WebGPU rest, spans mid and thick (96-160), fit cells, F u T u C u P (T read on its two bands and never required within; the move objective reads F u C u P)

ops.from: 2x WebGPU rest, thin spans (32-44), fit cells, F u C u P
ops.to: 2x WebGPU rest, thin spans (32-44), fit cells, F u T u C u P (T read on its two bands and never required within; the move objective reads F u C u P)

ops.from: 2x WebGPU inactive, every span, fit cells, F u C u P
ops.to: 2x WebGPU inactive, every span, fit cells, F u T u C u P (T read on its two bands and never required within; the move objective reads F u C u P)
every F, C and P cell of `cells` within (T1 output 1); a T cell is read on its bands and not required within
every F, C and P cell of `cells` within (T1 output 1); a T cell is read on its bands and not required within

ops.from: the final stage, WebGPU, 2x light, both poses, F u C u P less the referees, from T1's three outputs (t1.landing)
ops.to: the final stage, WebGPU, 2x light, both poses, F u T u C u P less the referees, from T1's three outputs (t1.landing); a T cell's fidelity and change on T1-fine, its away on T1-low

ops.from: every F cell within; no cell away with g > B; no cell overshoot; every other adopted row passing or its miss named; the twelve referees within at the exposure. Lands.
ops.to: every F cell within (no T cell is required within); no cell away with g > B (a T cell's on T1-low); no cell overshoot (a T cell's on T1-fine); every other adopted row passing or its miss named; the twelve referees within at the exposure. Lands.

ops.from: the F aggregate (median |log((k + eps) / (n + eps))|) at most half of c05's; no cell away with g > B; no cell overshoot; every referee within or an unchanged miss; every other adopted row passing or its miss named. Lands as improved, every F cell not within named.
ops.to: the F aggregate (median |log((k + eps) / (n + eps))|) at most half of c05's; no cell away with g > B (a T cell's on T1-low); no cell overshoot (a T cell's on T1-fine); every referee within or an unchanged miss; every other adopted row passing or its miss named. Lands as improved, every F cell not within named.

ops.from: a C or P cell that is a miss on c05 and unchanged stays a named miss; one away with g <= B is a named regression inside the budget; one with g > B fails the landing; M2 keeps its own 0.02 reference-relative tolerance as a regression stop
ops.to: a C or P cell that is a miss on c05 and unchanged stays a named miss; one away with g <= B is a named regression inside the budget; one with g > B fails the landing; M2 keeps its own 0.02 reference-relative tolerance as a regression stop; a T cell's budget reads T1-low's error growth (away with g <= B a named regression, g > B a failure)

ops.from: the gate partition of the light 0.25 profiles (every T1 cell less the canonical holdout and the referees), 2x WebGPU; the planner's pre-gate probe whitelist with the canonical calibration, validation and recorded sets; the loader refuses a referee row
ops.to: the gate partition of the light 0.25 profiles (every T1 cell less the canonical holdout and the referees), 2x WebGPU; the planner's pre-gate probe whitelist with the canonical calibration, validation and recorded sets; the loader refuses a referee row; among the fine backdrops (checkerboard-4, checkerboard-8, hc-text-7) that is 14 fit scenes per scale: their 19 scenes per scale less the five fine referees (F 11 of 15, T 3 of 4; Decision Log 7 item 4)

a candidate's dark endpoints are patch- and digest-identical to c05's dark documents, and its light endpoints are c05's on every leaf but the declared 2x leaves of the moves (and, in the receded light document, sizeHeavySecondShare), so its 1x-reaching leaves are c05's; a candidate carries the glass0.250 key because candidate mode refuses a shipped key, so the identity is patch-and-digest, and byte identity is the sealed documents' at the freeze (charter clause 5; Decision Log 7 item 5)
